pageDescription: Manage your products, pricing and stock.
addProductDescription: Create a new product, set its pricing and reorder level.
searchPlaceholder: Search by product name, SKU or barcode…
searchAriaLabel: Search products by name, SKU or barcode
noProductsMatchQuery: No products match “{q}”. Try a different search or clear the filters.
noProductsMatchFilters: No products match the current filters.
noProductsYetDescription: Add your first product to start tracking inventory and sales.
basicInformationDescription: Name and identifiers used on invoices and barcode scans.
pricingDescription: Cost price you pay suppliers and the price customers pay.
inventorySectionDescription: New products start at 0 stock. Record opening stock from the Inventory page after saving.
minStockHint: You will be alerted when stock falls below this level.
editDescription: Update details, pricing and reorder level for {name}.
editInventoryDescription: Current stock is managed from the Inventory page. The reorder level controls low-stock alerts.
archiveProductDescription: Archived products are deactivated and hidden from active lists.
archiveProductDetail: “{name}” will be marked as archived. Its stock level, stock history and sales records are preserved, but it will no longer count as an active product.
